SAL Stahiman Building | Parking Agreement | This Parking Agreement (the Agreement) is made and entered into as of the 15th day of _ March | 200%, by and between the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and | Davidson County (hereinafter “Metro”) and Stahlman Redevelopment Partners, LLC, a | Tennessee limited liability company (hereinafter “Stahlman Partners”). | Witnesseth: | WHEREAS, Stahlman Partners executed a development agreement with the | Metropolitan Development and Housing Agency dated February 10, 2004, for the purpose of converting the historic Building into a mix of residential and retail space (hereinafter “Development Agreement”); and WHEREAS, the Development Agreement acknowledged the construction of an underground public parking garage (the “Parking Facility”) across from the Stahlman Building along Union Street as part of and adjacent to the Metropolitan Courthouse Square construction project, and the Parking Facility may provide the future tenants of the Stahlman Building with an option for 24-hour parking; and WHEREAS, excavation for the Parking Facility is complete and construction is underway; and, NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the terms, conditions and mutual agreements by and between Metro and Stahlman Partners, the parties do hereby mutually agree as follows:
1. Term. The initial term (the of this Agreement shall begin - July 1,
2006 (the “Commencement Date”) and shall continue for a period of forty (40) years. Metro understands that the financing which Stahlman Partners shail obtain for Stahlman Building conversion will be a Federal Housing Administration (“FHA”) insured loan that will require the Term of this Agreement to be for forty (40) years. In the event this Loan is paid in full, the Term shall revert to a twenty (20) year Term plus two (2) ten (10) year extension terms less the amount of time expended under the forty (40) year Term. The extension terms shall be subject to the approval of the Metro Director of Finance, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed. Each option to extend shall be exercised by Stahlman Partners by giving notice to Metro not less than one (1) year in advance of a renewal Term and shall be subject to the approval of the Metropolitan Council.
2. Rate, Escalation and Adjustment. -The rental rate per Space will be $110 per month (the “Space Rent’). This rate shall be adjusted annually - thereafter during the term of the agreement on the anniversary date of this agreement. Each such adjustment shall be a percentage increase or decrease, equal to the -percentage change in the consumer price index (“CPI”) -, on the rate then in effect as of the previous January 1 of each year- For purposes of the agreement, CPI shall be the Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers, U.S. City Average, All Items (1982/1984 = 100), published by the U.S. Department of Labor, Bureau of Labor Statistics. !f the Department of Labor discontinues or substantially revises the manner of calculating this index, another federal government index that reflects cost of living or purchasing power changes and results in substantially similar changes when computing the rates, fees or charges established in this Agreement shall be selected by the parties and substituted herein. The Space Rent set forth in the foregoing paragraph is a rate based upon the parking spaces being available Page 2 of 11 ARCHIVE
twenty four hours a day, seven days a week and fifty two weeks a year. The parties agree that other rates based upon different usage or availability may be negotiated between the parties.
3. Casualty and Reconstruction. (A) In the event the Parking Facility is partially damaged by fire or other casualty which results in all or a portion of the Spaces becoming unusable or unaccessible, but other parking spaces in the Parking Facility remain usable and accessible, Metro agrees to repair to the previous condition such damage within a reasonable period of time after such destruction and Space Rent shall be abated proportionately from the date of such destruction according to the number of Spaces which are unusable or unaccessible until such Spaces are made available by Metro. Further, Metro agrees to make available to Stahlman Partners in the undamaged portion of the Parking Facility a number of parking spaces equal to a percentage determined by dividing the number of Spaces available to the public at-large by the total parking spaces in the Parking Facility available to the public- at-large times the 175 Spaces made available to Stahlman Partners. In the event that damage is so severe as to render it necessary in the exclusive judgment of Metro not to rebuild the same, Metro reserves the right not to repair. (B) In the event the Parking Facility is totally destroyed by fire or other casualty or damaged to the extent that none of the parking spaces in the Facility are usable and accessible, Space Rent shall abate until the Parking Facility is rebuilt and the Spaces are made usable and accessible and Metro agrees to make parking spaces available to Stahlman Partners in other facilities to the same extent that Metro accomodates other public at-large customers of the Parking Facility in other facilities. The decision to rebuild Page 3 of 11 ARCHIVE
the Parking Facility will be at the exclusive judgment of Metro. (C) In the event of damage or destruction to the StahIman Building to the extent that Stahlman Partners elects not to restore the building, Stahlman Partners shall have the right to terminate this Agreement upon giving one hundred eighty (180) days Notice to Metro 4, Parking Space Availability and Allocation. Metro shall allocate and guarantee a number of parking spaces (the “Spaces”) in the Parking Facility equal to 1.2 times the number of residential units in the Stahlman Building, with this number not to exceed 175 spaces for the exclusive use of tenants of the Stahlman Building. The Spaces and assigned card keys (the “Card” or “Cards”) shall be made available by Metro within three business (3) days after receipt of a written request from Stahlman Partners as apartment units are leased in the Stahlman Building. Prior to September 01, 2006 payment of Space Rent for each Space shall commence upon Metro's delivery of the assigned Card for such Space and shall continue until Stahiman Partners delivers the Card back to Metro. Monthly payment for all Spaces in use up to 175 Spaces shall commence on September 01, 2006.
5. Maintenance, Management and Security of Parking Facility. (A) Security for the Parking Facility shail consist of gates at locations to be determined, with twenty-four hour access by Card. Stahlman Partners will be responsible for distributing the Cards and notifying Metro of the persons provided such Cards and changes to those provided Cards. (B) Atleast one on-duty - attendant will be available from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m., Monday-Friday. Additional Security may be provided by Stahlman Page 4 of 11 ARCHIVE
Partners at their own expense and subject to the approval of Metro, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld. Metro agrees to maintain the sidewalks and curb cuts adjacent to the Parking Facility in accordance with applicable municipal statutes. (D) Metro agrees to keep the Parking Facility at all times in a clean, presentable, and sanitary condition and not to permit anything thereon which would vitiate any insurance carried by Metro on the Parking Facility. Metro shall perform all cleaning and normal maintenance functions. Metro agrees that maintenance and operation of the Parking Facility shall be consistent with comparable parking facilities as to age, capacity and availability to the public in the “Nashville Downtown Area”. The Nashville Downtown Area shall be defined as an area with the Cumberland River as the east boundary, Lafayette Street as the south boundary, I-40 as the west boundary and Jefferson Street as the north boundary. (E) Metro retains the right to temporarily close the facility or any part thereof, without liability to Stahlman Partners, if necessary to protect public health or safety or to repair or maintain the facility.
6. Waiver of Liability for Personal Property. Metro assumes no responsibility for any damage or loss of personal property of Stahlman Partners or any of its tenants. agrees to hold Metro harmless from any damage or loss of such personal property located on the Parking Facility premises but Stahlman Partners’ liability will in no event exceed the limit of Stahiman Partners’ liability insurance in the amount of $1,000,000 for each Page 5 of 11 AR CLV
occurrance and $2,000,000 in the general aggregate or as the limits of such insurance coverage may increase from time to time.
7. Assignment. Stahlman Partners may assign this Agreement to an entity established by the principals thereof for the purpose of carrying out the development of the Stahlman Building, but only with the prior consent of Metro which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed. Neither Stahlman Partners nor any assignee shall convey any interest in this Agreement whether by contract, sublease or otherwise without the prior consent of Metro, which consent not be unreasonably withheld or delayed. Notice should be provided as outlined in Paragraph 9(C). Notice of assignment of any rights to money due to Contractor under this Agreement must be sent to the attention of Metro’s Chief Accountant, Division of Accounts, Department of Finance, 222 Third Avenue North, Suite 750, Nashville, TN 37201.
8. Notice. Notices required herein may be given by registered or certified or express mail by depositing the same in the United States Mail or by private courier in the continental United States, postage prepaid. Either party shall have the right, by giving written notice to the other, to change the address at which its notices are to be received. All rents shall also be paid to the same address. Until any such change is made, notices to Metro shall be delivered as follows: METROPOLITAN GOVERNMENT ATTN: KEN MAYNARD PUBLIC PROPERTY DIRECTOR 222 AVE NORTH, SUITE 701 NASHVILLE, TN 37201 (615) 880-2632 Notice to Stahlman Partners shall be sent by overnight courier service, signature required for delivery, or certified mail, return receipt requested, to: Page 6 of 11 ARCHIVE
STAHLMAN REDEVELOPMENT PARTNERS, LLC ATTN: Robert C.H. Mathews, III 300 BROADWAY NASHVILLE, TN 37201
9. Default. (A) By StahIman Partners: Non-payment of the Rates under the terms of this Agreement by Stahlman Partners shall give Metro the right to terminate the Agreement provided Metro gives Stahlman Partners notice of such non-payment and Partners fails to cure the same within thirty (30) days thereafter. (B) By Metro: In the event Metro shall fail to perform any of its obligations hereunder, including without limitation, general Parking Facility appearance, maintenance, restoration of damage caused by fire or other casualty, and structural repairs, Stahlman Partners shall be entitled to terminate the Agreement provided Stahlman Partners shall give Metro notice of such failure to perform and Metro fails to cure the same within thirty (30) days thereafter.
10. Emergency Repairs. Metro reserves the right to temporarily stop services in the Parking Facility, wnen in Metro’s reasonable judgment, the same is deemed necessary by reason of accident, emergency or for repairs, alterations, replacements or improvements thereto provided that except in case of emergency, Metro will notify Partners in advance, if possible, of any such stoppage and, if ascertainable, its estimated duration, and will proceed with the work necessary to resume such service as promptly as possible and in a manner and at Page 7 of 11 ARCHIVE
times, including after business hours, so as not to unduly interfere with or impair Stahlman Partners’ tenants’ use of the Spaces.
11. Personnel Policy. Stahiman makes oath that, by its employment standards and practices, it does not subscribe to any personnel policy which permits or allows for the promotion, demotion, dismissal, or laying off of any individual! due to his race, creed, color, national origin, gender or disability.
12. Conflict of Interest. declares that as of the effective date of this Agreement, neither the Mayor nor any member of the Metropolitan Council, nor the director of any department of the Metropolitan Government, nor any other Metropolitan Governmental official or employee is directly or indirectly interested in this Agreement and, furthermore, pledges that it will notify Metro in writing should any of the above-referenced persons become either directly or indirectly interested in this Agreement. In addition, declares that as of the effective date of this Agreement, neither it nor any of the principals therein have given or donated, or promised to give or donate, either directly or indirectly, to any official or employee of the Metropolitan Government or to anyone else for its benefit, any sum of money or other thing of value or aid or assist in obtaining this Agreement. Furthermore, Stahlman pledges that neither it nor any officer or employee of the Metropolitan Government, or to anyone else for his benefit, has given any sum of money or other thing of value for aid or assistance in obtaining any amendment or modification to this Agreement. 13. (A) Forum. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Tennessee, without reservation. Any suit, action, or proceeding with Page 8 of 11 ARCHIVE
respect to this Agreement, or any judgment entered by any court in respect thereof shall only be brought in either the Circuit or Chancery courts of the State of Tennessee, County of Davidson. (B) Integration. This Agreement represents the full and complete understanding of the parties, and any amendments hereto shall be integrated as though fully copied herein. (C) If any section of this Agreement is found unlawful or illegal or becomes so, the remainder of the contracted terms shall remain in full force and effect. (D) The terms of this Agreement shall be modified only by a written addendum signed by both Metro and Stahlman Partners and approved as required by law. (E) This Agreement may be terminated should Metro or superior governmental authority decide to use the Premises for a governmental purpose. Upon such event, Metro shall. use reasonable efforts to provide suitable alternative space subject to the same terms and conditions of this Agreement. (F) Upon the Ending Date or earlier termination of this Agreement, Stahlman Partners shall peaceably deliver up and surrender the Premises to Metro in the same condition as on the Commencement Date. (G) herein to the contrary notwithstanding, Stahiman Partners is not the agent of Metro. The parties hereto are neither partners Page 9 of 11 ARCHIVE
venturers and neither shall the parties hold themselves out to be partners or joint venturers. (H) The individuals executing this Agreement personally warrant that they have full authority to execute this Agreement on behalf of the entity for whom they are acting herein. (I) Metro shall, at any time and from time to time, within thirty (30) days following written request from Stahiman Partners, execute, acknowledge and deliver to Stahlman Partners a written statement certifying that this Agreement is in full force and effect and unmodified (or, if modified, stating the nature of such modification), and certifying that there are not, to Metro’s knowledge, any uncured defaults on the part of Partners hereunder, or specifying such defaults if any are claimed. Any such statement may be relied upon by any prospective purchaser of a material interest in the Stahlman Partners or any institutional creditor of Stahiman Partners.
14. This Agreement will not take effect until approved by the authorized officials of Metro and by ordinance of the Metropolitan Council. Page 10 of 11 ARCHIVE
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the year and date above written.
